role_field_semantics.contract: Lint applies. The literal value of this constant is canonical and tests must NOT pin a duplicate literal — they must import the constant from its source_module.
role_field_semantics.default: Registered for documentation purposes only. The lint scanner skips entries with role: 'default' (no production-side literal-pin checking applied).

_meta.reconciliation_note: Backend's TOML registry (f9_ssot_constants.toml) dropped DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL with an inline-comment rationale. Mobile encodes the contract-vs-default distinction explicitly at the schema level (the role field) so future entries inherit the classification vocabulary rather than relying on tribal knowledge or inline TOML comments. Phase 191D Commit 3 ships with all initial entries as role: 'contract' — no role: 'default' entries identified yet on the mobile surface; the field exists in the schema for future use.

constants.name: DEFAULT_BASE_URL
constants.description: Dev backend URL the API client falls back to when neither options.baseUrl nor Config.API_BASE_URL is set. The 10.0.2.2:8000 value is the Android emulator host loopback; pinned by emulator regression coverage. Tests must import and contract-pin if literal-checked.

constants.name: DTC_SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS
constants.description: Debounce delay (ms) for the DTC search hook. UX guarantee: 300ms is the snappy-but-not-API-pounding threshold. Tests pin via fake-timers; bumping requires UX sign-off.

constants.name: DTC_SEARCH_LIMIT
constants.description: Page-size cap on DTC search results. 50 is the backend's preferred page size; deeper paging requires query refinement.

constants.name: PER_SESSION_COUNT_CAP
constants.description: Mobile-side mirror of backend per-session video count cap. Used as a fast UI hint to hide the Record button before the user taps and gets a 402. Backend is authoritative.

constants.name: PER_SESSION_BYTES_CAP
constants.description: Mobile-side mirror of backend per-session size cap (500 MB = 500 * 1024 * 1024 bytes). Pre-empts the Record button before a 402 round-trip. Backend is authoritative.

constants.name: POLL_INTERVAL_MS
constants.description: Polling interval while video analysis is in flight. 5s balances snappy badge updates against backend pressure. Tests pin via fake-timers.

constants.name: MAX_VIDEOS_PER_SESSION
constants.description: Per-session video count cap, surfaced in screen UI copy (at-cap badges, count tickers). Mobile-side mirror of backend motodiag.api.routes.videos.PER_SESSION_COUNT_CAP. Phase 191D Commit 3 consolidated this from duplicated declarations in SessionDetailScreen.tsx + VideoCaptureScreen.tsx into src/types/video.ts as the canonical SSOT.
